title: My voicemail came from my own number
style_prompt: cinematic horror film still, dark, moody, low key lighting, 35mm film grain, desaturated, realistic, suburban American house at night, no text, no watermark
hook_text: My voicemail came from my own number.

scenes.narration: My voicemail came from my own number.

shots.prompt: close up of a smartphone on a bedside table at night showing a voicemail screen, glowing blue, dark bedroom

scenes.narration: It was 3:06 a.m. The timestamp said 3:07 tomorrow. I live alone. Nobody else has my phone.

shots.prompt: smartphone lock screen glowing in the dark, bedroom shadows

scenes.narration: I pressed play. It was my voice. Whispering. Terrified. I was breathing hard, like I was hiding.

shots.prompt: phone speaker glowing on a dark nightstand, soundwave light

scenes.narration: Don't open the closet. Whatever you hear, it's not me. Please. Just listen to me. Get out of the house.

shots.prompt: dark bedroom closet door slightly ajar, blackness inside, no person visible

scenes.narration: Then a knock. Soft. From inside the closet. Like someone tapping with one finger.

shots.prompt: closed wooden closet door in a dark bedroom, faint blue phone glow on it

scenes.narration: A whisper came through the crack. My voice again. Open it. It's freezing in here. It sounded warm and familiar and wrong. I wanted to believe it. My hand reached for the handle.

shots.prompt: narrow gap of a closet door in the dark, cold mist at the crack, no face

scenes.narration: I checked the voicemail. It was still playing. In my hand. Whispering the same words. My thumb was shaking on the screen.

shots.prompt: smartphone in a hand in the dark, voicemail screen playing, blue glow

scenes.narration: So who was talking in the closet? The voicemail stopped. The closet said it again. Only closer. The handle began to turn.

shots.prompt: closet door in the dark, the handle slowly turning, no person visible

scenes.narration: So tell me. Do you open the closet, or run?

overlays.text: Do you open the closet, or run?

shots.prompt: close up of a smartphone on a bedside table at night showing a voicemail screen, glowing blue, dark bedroom
